canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Primary page background, elevated card surfaces

ghost-fog.$description: Ghost Fog — Subtle background panels, light hover states, decorative borders. This is a very light, almost white grey

border-mist.$description: Border Mist — Secondary background panels, subtle section dividers

deep-ocean.$description: Deep Ocean — Primary text color, bold accents, brand elements, active states. This particular cool blue-grey defines the brand's primary visual identity

text-slate.$description: Text Slate — Darkest text for contrast on light backgrounds

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Secondary text, muted links, subtle button borders

light-steel.$description: Light Steel — Subtle button borders, decorative strokes, light element outlines

black-ink.$description: Black Ink — Iconography, strong text emphasis, borders on dark elements

libre-caslon-condensed.$description: Headline typeface. Its delicate, almost whispery quality (despite large sizes) evokes a crafted, sophisticated brand rather than shouting for attention. letter-spacing reduces at smaller headline sizes.

circular-pro.$description: Body copy, navigation, buttons, and all functional text. The slightly wider letter spacing gives it an airy, open feel, enhancing the minimalist aesthetic.
